answer: A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, as the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The whisper multiplier is published, charged in spiral, and mesa lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 9 for every identity already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A farm of 3495 identities would post 3804 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
